changes: Replace the card's formula d sin θ = mλ with the VCE small-angle form for fringe spacing, Δx = λD/a, where a is the slit separation and D is the distance from the slits to the screen.
Define the symbols in the VCE form (a, D and Δx) in place of d, θ and m, so the formula matches what Units 3 and 4 students are expected to use.

changes: Replace the d sin θ = mλ line with the VCE fringe spacing formula Δx = λL/d, where L is the slit-to-screen distance, as given on the VCE formula sheet.
Describe the bright and dark fringes using VCE path difference terms: bright where the path difference is nλ, dark where it is (n − ½)λ.
Note that a larger slit-to-screen distance L also spreads the fringes, as the Study Design asks students to vary L.
